recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, character-driven montage styled after a 1970s pinball machine backglass, featuring hand-drawn portraits with heavy black outlines, set against a backdrop of swirling psychedelic color bands and mechanical score counters.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters layered over concentric, curved color bands
Mechanical score display integrated into the upper-right quadrant
Bold, bulbous typography anchored in the lower-left
Warm, sun-drenched color palette contrasting with deep black line work
coreInvariants: Heavy black ink-style outlines for all figures
Flat color fills with minimal stipple shading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central female and male figure dominate the right-center, surrounded by smaller supporting characters in a circular flow.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white bulbous title text in the bottom left serves as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Clockwise spiral starting from the title, moving through the characters on the left, up to the score, and down through the main subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is 'horror vacui' style, filled with characters and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and muted cream provide the base background tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black outlines and shadows define form and separate layers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange, teal, and magenta used in the background stripes and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation palette mimicking aged paper and vintage ink.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, high-contrast sans serif with liquid-like curves.
letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight on the bottom of characters
Heavy black drop shadow to lift text from the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Internal counters are minimized to small slits
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the fluid display type with a rigid, geometric monospaced font for the score and metadata to mimic machine-stamped text.
graphicDevices: Halftone dot patterns for subtle shading

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Bell Bottom or Cooper Black variant

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s pinball backglass illustration. Include a montage of characters in a comic-book style with heavy black outlines. Background features concentric curved bands of orange, teal, and yellow. Include a mechanical 6-digit score counter in the top right. Leave the bottom left area clear for large text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold, bulbous custom lettering in a cream color with a thick black drop shadow. The text should be arched and tightly packed in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the line work consistently thick and black?
Does the color palette feel aged and warm?
Is the score counter rendered with mechanical depth?
Is the main title text overlapping itself slightly?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 70s era-appropriate clothing and hair styles
Ensure no digital-looking glows are present
Verify the 'pinball frame' border is intact
Confirm the score counter looks like physical plastic reels
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Pinball Aesthetic + Psychedelic Montage + Heavy Ink Outlines + Bulbous Liquid Typography
